tasks.description:

**Files:**
- Create: `package.json`, `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, `tsconfig.base.json`, `.gitignore`, `CLAUDE.md`

tasks.description:

tasks.subject: Task 5: Git worktree operations and local merge
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pure functions over `git` for everything the lifecycle needs: idempotent worktree creation, commit counting since a start commit, diff against base, worktree removal, and a local merge that reports conflicting files without leaving the primary checkout mid-merge.

**Files:**
- Create: `packages/daemon/src/git/git.ts`, `packages/daemon/src/git/git.test.ts`, `packages/daemon/src/test/tmpgit.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `ensureWorktree` creates `<worktreesDir>/<repoId>/<beadId>` on branch `bead/<beadId>` from `base_branch`; a second call returns the same path with `created: false`; after deleting the directory it recreates on the existing branch
- [ ] `commitsSince(path, start)` counts commits made in the worktree after `start`
- [ ] `diffAgainstBase` shows only the branch's changes (three-dot diff)
- [ ] `mergeLocal` merges a clean branch with `--no-ff` and returns `{ ok: true }`; on conflict it returns the conflicting file list, aborts, and leaves base's HEAD unchanged
- [ ] `mergeLocal` throws a `GitError` when the primary checkout is not on base or is dirty
- [ ] `removeWorktree` deletes the directory and the branch

**Verify:** `pnpm --filter @overseer/daemon test -- git` → PASS


tasks.subject: Task 6: Event bus and session manager
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A typed in-process bus and a `SessionManager` that starts adapter sessions, persists every event, tracks pid and native session id, decides when a worker session ends, and emits `session:ended` with the facts the lifecycle needs.

**Files:**
- Create: `packages/daemon/src/bus.ts`, `packages/daemon/src/sessions/manager.ts`, `packages/daemon/src/sessions/manager.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `start()` inserts a `running` session row and returns it; `process_start` updates `pid`/`pid_started_at`
- [ ] Every adapter event is appended to `events` with increasing `seq` and emitted on the bus as `event`
- [ ] On `turn_end` the row gets `native_session_id` and `cost`; a worker session (not `keepAlive`) with no queued sends is ended via `adapter.end`
- [ ] `send()` before `turn_end` keeps the session alive through that `turn_end`
- [ ] Stream close after an `error` with no later `turn_end` → status `failed`; otherwise `ended`. `session:ended` carries `lastText`, `lastError`, `files`
- [ ] `keepAlive` sessions never auto-end; `interrupt()` kills and ends

**Verify:** `pnpm --filter @overseer/daemon test -- sessions` → PASS

```json:metadata
{"files": ["packages/daemon/src/bus.ts", "packages/daemon/src/sessions/manager.ts"], "verifyCommand": "pnpm --filter @overseer/daemon test -- sessions", "acceptanceCriteria": ["start inserts running row; process_start updates pid", "every event persisted with seq and emitted on bus", "turn_end stores native id and cost and ends a worker with no queued sends", "queued send survives one turn_end", "error without later turn_end marks failed", "keepAlive never auto-ends; interrupt kills and ends"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Lifecycle state machine and crash recovery
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The spec 4.3 loop as one class: `spawnWorker` (claim, worktree, prompt, session), the session-end rule (new commits → verify → review; none → failed and reopened), `requestMerge`, `merge`, `reject`, and `recover`. Verified end to end with the fake adapter, the memory task store and a temp git repo.

**Files:**
- Create: `packages/daemon/prompts/worker.md`, `packages/daemon/src/lifecycle/prompt.ts`, `packages/daemon/src/lifecycle/prompt.test.ts`, `packages/daemon/src/lifecycle/verify.ts`, `packages/daemon/src/lifecycle/verify.test.ts`, `packages/daemon/src/git/provider.ts`, `packages/daemon/src/lifecycle/lifecycle.ts`, `packages/daemon/src/lifecycle/lifecycle.test.ts`, `packages/daemon/src/test/until.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `spawnWorker` sets the bead `in_progress`, clears any `overseer:*` label, creates or reuses the worktree, records `start_commit`, starts a worker session whose prompt contains the bead title, branch, any rejection note, any conflict files and the optional instructions
- [ ] `spawnWorker` refuses when the bead already has a running session, when the repo is at `worker_limit`, when the bead is closed, or when `bd` is unavailable
- [ ] Session end with new commits: label `overseer:verifying` → verify command runs in the worktree → `verify_status`/`verify_output` stored → label `overseer:review`; `conflict_files` cleared
- [ ] Session end without new commits: session `failed`, bead `open`, no phase label, note appended with the last error or assistant text
- [ ] `requestMerge` refuses unless `verify_status === 'pass'`; stores `review_note`
- [ ] `merge` requires phase `review`; on success closes the bead, sets `overseer:merged`, records `merged_at`, removes the worktree; on conflict stores `conflict_files`, notifies the orchestrator, throws `MergeConflictError`, keeps the task in review
- [ ] `reject` sets bead `open` + `overseer:rejected`, appends `Rejected: <note>`, clears `review_note`, keeps the worktree
- [ ] `recover` kills any live process of a `running` session, marks it ended, and applies the session-end rule

**Verify:** `pnpm --filter @overseer/daemon test -- lifecycle` → PASS

```json:metadata
{"files": ["packages/daemon/prompts/worker.md", "packages/daemon/src/lifecycle/prompt.ts", "packages/daemon/src/lifecycle/verify.ts", "packages/daemon/src/lifecycle/lifecycle.ts", "packages/daemon/src/git/provider.ts", "packages/daemon/src/test/until.ts"], "verifyCommand": "pnpm --filter @overseer/daemon test -- lifecycle", "acceptanceCriteria": ["spawnWorker claims, clears phase, reuses worktree, records start_commit, prompt carries title/branch/notes/conflicts/instructions", "spawnWorker refuses duplicate, limit, closed bead, missing bd", "session end with commits verifies and reaches review; without commits fails and reopens with note", "requestMerge requires verify pass and stores review_note", "merge closes, labels merged, removes worktree; conflict stores files, notifies, throws, stays in review", "reject reopens with rejected label and note, keeps worktree", "recover kills live processes and applies the session-end rule"], "modelTier": "frontier"}
```

tasks.description:
